context: A teen and her aunt catch up during a holiday visit
purpose: Teach: カレンダー/シャツ/ファミリー/出かける/受け取る/早々/嬉しく/両手

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、年明け早々に来てくれてありがとうね。
lines.en: Sakura, thanks for coming to visit so early in the new year.
lines.style: Warm aunt greeting her niece with affection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ううん、こっちこそ。ファミリーで集まれるの久しぶりで嬉しいよ。
lines.en: No, thank you. It's been so long since the family gathered.
lines.style: Cheerful teen expressing genuine happiness about the reunion.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そのシャツ可愛いね。お母さんが買ってくれたの?
lines.en: That shirt is cute. Did your mom buy it for you?
lines.style: Friendly aunt noticing niece's outfit with curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、クリスマスにもらったんだ。なおこおばさんからのカレンダーも届いたよ、すごく嬉しくて壁に貼ったの。
lines.en: Yeah, I got it for Christmas. Your calendar came too, I was so happy I put it on the wall.
lines.style: Grateful teen sharing how much she liked the gift.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 気に入ってくれてよかった。今日はみんなでどこか出かける予定?
lines.en: I'm glad you liked it. Are you all going out somewhere today?
lines.style: Aunt eagerly asking about holiday plans together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、お父さんが初詣に行こうって。おばちゃんも一緒に行こうよ。
lines.en: Yeah, Dad wants to go to the shrine. Please come with us.
lines.style: Teen warmly inviting her aunt to join the outing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: もちろん行くよ。あ、お年玉あるから、両手でちゃんと受け取るのよ。
lines.en: Of course I'm coming. Oh, I've got your New Year money, you take it properly with both hands now.
lines.style: Playful aunt teasing about the traditional money envelope ritual.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった、ありがとうおばちゃん!じゃあ準備してくるね。
lines.en: Yay, thanks Auntie. I'll go get ready then.
lines.style: Excited teen bouncing off to prepare for the outing.
